name: What types of tile are best suited for a luxury bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: What types of tile are best suited for a luxury bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a luxury bathroom renovation, porcelain, ceramic, natural stone (marble, granite, travertine), and glass tiles are frequently selected due to their durability, aesthetic versatility, and ability to elevate the design. Porcelain is highly water-resistant and durable, making it ideal for floors and shower surrounds. Natural stone offers a unique, opulent look but requires more maintenance and sealing. When making your selection, consider both the visual impact and the long-term maintenance requirements to ensure it aligns with your lifestyle and desired homeowner experience. We guide clients through material selection, balancing beauty with practical considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain, ceramic, natural stone, and glass tiles are excellent choices for luxury bathrooms. Consider durability, aesthetic, and maintenance to align with your lifestyle.
